name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for all EXCAVA prompts above 5K tokens. It’s the only 12B-class model Anthropic lists as actively supported, and its 128K context window crushes Mistral Large 2’s 128K for long-form reasoning. Trade-off: slower inference than smaller models, but EXCAVA’s power ceiling rises more than enough to justify the delay.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s real risk is prompt collapse under long contexts—its 128K window is a red herring for EXCAVA’s prompts, which average 8K tokens but spike to 20K with tool calls. Switch to Mistral Large 2 12.8B instead; its 128K window is stable, and its 12.8B size keeps inference fast enough to avoid power ceiling loss. Test both on a 15K-token prompt with tool calls—if Maverick’s output degrades before Mistral’s, the switch is settled.
